title: Lyft Cost Estimate
description: An estimated cost, distance, and duration for a Lyft ride between two locations for a specific ride type.

ride_type.description: Identifier for the type of Lyft ride.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the ride type.

estimated_cost_cents_min.description: Lower bound of the estimated cost in cents.

estimated_cost_cents_max.description: Upper bound of the estimated cost in cents.

estimated_distance_miles.description: Estimated distance of the ride in miles.

estimated_duration_seconds.description: Estimated duration of the ride in seconds.

primetime_percentage.description: Current Prime Time percentage applied to the cost estimate, formatted as a percentage string such as 25%.

primetime_confirmation_token.description: A token that must be included when requesting a ride during Prime Time pricing.
